name: monodify
description: Monodify — Nasheed app with liquid glass UI

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:clean: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('client/dist',{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}" && cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:clean && firebase deploy --only hosting
